observation: The V6.4 branch starts exactly at the frozen V6.3 terminal commit; main was fast-forwarded without altering the V6.3 closeout.
diagnosis: The only P0 failure was a pytest console-entry import-path mismatch before any quality read.
action: Use python -m pytest for the single narrow validation and move directly to the minimal native-UQ experiment instead of expanding protocol or regression scaffolding.

observation: Existing V6.3 native sidecars cover 72 development units in 3.4 GiB and can support a zero-GPU mechanism diagnostic.
diagnosis: Generating a full fresh cohort before checking feature-density signal would spend disk and wall time without reducing the first-order method uncertainty.
action: Freeze one retrospective U0/U2 comparison, keep old scenes in mechanism-only scope, and generate fresh sidecars only if the native density score shows useful scene-level signal.

observation: Geometry-conditioned native feature density improved pooled AUROC by 0.053146 and AUPRC by 0.016288 over the best U0 score, with AUROC support in both retrospective evaluation scenes.
diagnosis: Native BEV/logit density carries uncertainty signal that softmax confidence misses, but high FPR@95TPR and the retrospective denominator prevent an authority claim.
action: Promote only to fresh-cohort validation with the exact PCA-16/GMM-4 configuration; do not unlock calibration, LoRA, or parameter sweeps.

observation: Nine locally processed scenes remain outside the V6.1-V6.3 quality-read ledger, so a compact fresh cohort is available without downloading another 29.4 GiB nuScenes blob archive.
diagnosis: The initial all-history exclusion was overly broad; the V6.4 plan defines legacy by V6.1-V6.3 quality use, not by any earlier metadata mention.
action: Freeze four metadata-diverse fit scenes and two evaluation scenes, reuse the proven native extractor, and keep evaluation target sealed.

observation: The first formal entrance called shutil.disk_usage on a task directory that did not yet exist and failed before creating a run leaf.
diagnosis: The inherited runner assumes its task parent already exists; the V6.4 wrapper introduced a new task path without establishing that precondition.
action: Create only the task parent before the disk probe and rerun as r2 with every scientific and resource setting unchanged.

observation: Blocked partial r2 materialized all 12 targets for scene-0230, while val-split scenes failed at lookup because the frozen IR-WM metadata contains only train temporal scenes.
diagnosis: Processed/raw availability is insufficient for an inherited temporal model; cohort capability selection must include membership in the exact frozen temporal metadata before launching workers.
action: Preserve r2 without reuse, refreeze six quality-unread train-temporal scenes, preprocess only evaluation indices 276 and 756 from local raw data, and use a new r3 leaf for the full denominator.

observation: Fresh r3 completed all 72 native units in 172.21 seconds with a 4.13 GiB maximum worker peak; the first closeout reader then guessed a non-existent summary filename.
diagnosis: The inherited extractor is resource-suitable, while downstream readers must follow its actual output contract instead of deriving filenames from the V6.4 task name.
action: Close P2 as capability-only, enumerate run-root outputs before reading P2_SUMMARY.json, and move directly to a preregistered fresh evidence/UQ evaluation without rerunning sidecars.

observation: The existing evidence and surface materializers already provide the exact method-visible hidden-FREE denominator used by the retrospective UQ diagnostic.
diagnosis: A new compiler stack is unnecessary for the first fresh scientific decision; only task identity and scene-to-native-partition lookup prevent direct reuse.
action: Generalize those two plumbing fields, freeze the unchanged PCA-16/GMM-4 model with two concise AUROC gates, and execute one evidence-surface-UQ chain without sweeps.

observation: All 72 fresh evidence units completed in 118.29 seconds and 68.4 MB with no source-role overlap; an earlier launcher string was intercepted by local PowerShell before SSH.
diagnosis: Full evidence grids are cheap enough to materialize directly, while mixed-shell subexpressions are an avoidable operations hazard unrelated to the run.
action: Keep query sampling disabled, record the launcher issue as pre-run only, and proceed directly to the fixed surface corpus without an extra probe.

observation: The inherited surface compiler historically needs 13.21 hours for 72 units and the fresh run produced no unit after about four minutes because it builds several payload families unused by U0/U2.
diagnosis: The bottleneck is protocol overreach rather than unavailable compute; OCCUQ's uncertainty object is the native occupancy voxel, so signed-distance and patch registries are unnecessary for this decision.
action: Stop and retain the exact surface partial before score read, freeze a unique native boundary-voxel denominator with unchanged model and gates, and execute one CPU r1 without a probe or sweep.

observation: The frozen occupied-boundary fit set contained only 43 voxels predicted FREE, so the retrospective two-geometry GMM failed before fitting or evaluating either fresh scene.
diagnosis: Predicted-geometry conditioning assumes a mixed region; OCCUQ instead learns voxel feature densities by true class and marginalizes them, while this region is already conditioned structurally as an occupied boundary.
action: Fit one boundary-global diagonal GMM-4 with every model, scene, denominator, seed, and gate otherwise unchanged; retain r1 and execute only r2.
